name: Default
shortDescription: Long-term Prometheus metrics storage in monolithic mode, with a remote write endpoint, a PromQL query API for Grafana and persistent local block storage.

alerts.message: Mimir runs with multi-tenancy disabled and has no built-in authentication: anyone who knows the domain can push metrics to https://<domain>/api/v1/push and query them. Do not store sensitive data, or restrict access in front of the app.
